Their allowed agents have the relevant supplied active project-scoped trusted capability claims, including data.change and integration.consumer, with testing.verification additionally present for the verifier; pending-only claims and personas are not needed to justify eligibility. A distinct configured project reviewer satisfies the supplied earlier review prerequisite. No unresolved material Decision is supplied, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct source digest domains and trim-only PRD persistence normalization. Historical operations are explicitly old-bundle records rather than candidate evidence for this bundle. This approval is based solely on the supplied frozen review data; I did not execute code, independently recompute digests, or provide a human attestation.
